name: Bomberman 64: Recompiled
problems: requires a legally dumped US N64 ROM of Bomberman 64, no game assets included
only Windows executable provided at initial release, other OS support planned
minor graphical clipping issue in credits screen
source_notes: Uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile the original N64 binary into a native PC port, using headers from the Bomberman 64 decompilation project.
